steps.what: Retrieve manuscript version, review criteria and submission instructions
Read manuscripts and examine their evidence and argument
Judge scholarly contribution, weaknesses and publication recommendation
Write reviewer report and confidential editorial comments
Submit final reviewer report to the editor

tasks.design: Configure reviewer-instruction links and native report headings in {DOCS}, using the publisher's {PARTNER_PORTAL} for the actual submission. Manuscript reading, scholarly judgement and substantive report writing stay with the reviewer; only repeated reference and layout handling is reduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Review instructions and report structures require repeated clerical handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document headings and local reference links can reduce a small amount of assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing originality, evidence, interpretation and the fairness of the recommendation.
tasks.human_edge: Independent scholarly judgement and constructive critique.
tasks.altitude: A clearer reviewer record with modest clerical support.

reach.learn: Separate disagreement from a demonstrable weakness

evidence.claim: Native review headings and instruction links may reduce clerical handling; substantive peer review is not automated in this proposal.

assumptions: Includes actual reviewer-report writing and external submission, not just reading. The proposal does not assume permission to upload confidential manuscripts to a model.

Teacher captures manuscript identifier and version, journal criteria and required report headings in s1, produces critical observations in s2 and conclusions in s3, then writes the actual report in s4. Capture remains priced; missing instructions or uncertain manuscript versions are resolved manually.
Use native local document styles and reviewer-form headings first. No generative peer review, autonomous recommendation or unlisted machine action is proposed.
Ordinary author saves are fully retained within s4 without self-approval; the real editor submission has its own final-version check.
unknowns: Current instruction and report handling time
research_questions: Do native report headings reduce layout time while leaving substantive critique and confidentiality intact?

already_counted.description: Review packet and written report checks

incremental.description: Maintain reviewer layouts and instruction links

approvals.approved_version: Exact reviewer report, confidential comments, recommendation, manuscript version and editorial destination; changes require renewed final-version checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R94.25 gross5.75 less1 upkeep gives central4.75. Low retains all10 packet handling and24/25 report writing when the journal uses an unfamiliar form: gross1 less1=0. High retains9/10 packet handling and23/25 writing with reusable native headings and current instruction links: gross3 less1=2. Manuscript reading, scholarly judgement and actual submission remain full.

tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events

steps.what: Look up current campus and community event details
Clarify the teacher's contribution and community needs
Write event contribution notes and preparation materials
Participate in the event and engage with attendees
Record event follow-up notes and agreed actions

tasks.design: Configure event-reference links in {CALENDAR} and short preparation and follow-up layouts in {DOCS}. Participation stays personal; actual preparation writing and post-event recording are separate phases with their own time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Event context and recurring preparation and action headings are handled repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference links and document structures can reduce small amounts of repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Engaging thoughtfully with the community and responding to the event as it unfolds.
tasks.altitude: Protect participation time while simplifying its supporting notes.

reach.learn: Adapt a contribution to the people present

evidence.claim: Native event links and note structures may reduce supporting handling; live community participation is not automated.

assumptions: Scenario includes existing preparation and follow-up notes, not a newly invented event-management role. Validate that these notes occur today; any actual later send needs a distinct action.

Organiser produces the event invitation and schedule as part of organising work, whose capture remains there. Teacher captures date, place, contribution and source version in s1-s3, and actual follow-up points in s5, with focal capture time counted. Missing or changed details require manual clarification.
Native calendar links and note headings come first. No automatic attendance capture, inferred engagement or unlisted notification is proposed.
Ordinary author saves stay fully retained without an approval stage.
unknowns: Existing event reference and note structure
Whether a formal public presentation is part of the contribution
research_questions: Do native links and note layouts reduce handling without losing changed event details or follow-up commitments?

already_counted.description: Event reference and supporting note checks

incremental.description: Maintain event links and note headings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R93 gross7 less1 upkeep gives central6. Low retains all10 reference lookup,all15 preparation and9/10 follow-up writing when the contribution is unique: gross1 less1=0. High retains9/10 lookup,13/15 preparation and9/10 follow-up with a familiar contribution and compatible headings: gross4 less1=3. Clarification and actual participation remain full.

tasks.short: Serve on academic and administrative committees

steps.what: Retrieve current committee papers and institutional policy references
Write the teacher's committee briefing and proposed contribution

loop.purpose: Express the member's chosen briefing points clearly
loop.input: selected argument points and supplied committee papers
loop.check: Teacher checks policy meaning, attribution and unsupported recommendations
loop.stop: One revision then manual writing if the member's position changes
loop.why_not_simpler: The contribution needs case-specific prose beyond agenda headings

steps.what: Serve in committee deliberation and exercise academic judgement
Write the member's committee follow-up and contribution record
Send the member's final follow-up contribution to the committee

tasks.design: Configure current committee-paper links and contribution layouts in {DOCS}; a bounded loop supports the member's own briefing points. Deliberation, post-meeting record writing and the final internal {EMAIL} send are separately priced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Committee sources and the member's written contributions are assembled repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native references and source-bound drafting can reduce clerical and prose preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Academic policy judgement and reaching a considered position with colleagues.
tasks.altitude: Less contribution assembly and more attention to committee substance.

reach.task: Trace committee contributions to current policy
reach.learn: Keep member proposals distinct from committee decisions

evidence.claim: Native committee references and bounded briefing drafts may reduce preparation; no committee time case is supplied in the digest.

assumptions: Includes the member's actual briefing and follow-up writing, not an invented secretary role or authority to approve committee decisions.

Committee secretariat produces agenda and papers during its own work. Teacher captures paper and policy versions in s1, their selected argument points in s2 and actual member follow-up in s4; all focal reading and capture are counted. Missing or disputed decisions remain unresolved and are clarified manually.
Native linked papers and contribution headings come first; the loop does not infer committee agreement or decide policy.
Same-system author saves remain fully retained without self-approval. The real colleague send has a final-version gate.
unknowns: Whether briefings and follow-up contributions are routinely written
Permitted processing of confidential committee papers
research_questions: Can a bounded briefing draft reduce writing while preserving the member's position and current policy references?

incremental.description: Maintain reference layouts and inspect briefing draft errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact member contribution, stated unresolved points and committee recipients; edits require renewed final-version checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R84 gross16 less3 upkeep gives central13. Low retains14/15 source handling,18/20 briefing writing and19/20 follow-up with unfamiliar policy and limited template fit: gross4 less3=1. High retains13/15 source handling,14/20 briefing and17/20 follow-up with current linked papers and reusable contribution headings: gross11 less3=8. Deliberation and the actual send remain full.

steps.what: Retrieve departmental requests, resources and current commitments
Confer with staff about departmental needs and constraints
Set department priorities and decide administrative assignments
Write department plans, decisions and assignment records
outputs: checked department plan and assignment record

steps.what: Communicate final departmental decisions and assignments to staff
inputs: checked department plan and assignment record
outputs: staff informed of decisions and assignments

steps.what: Update departmental action status and follow-up records
inputs: checked department plan and assignment record

tasks.design: Configure a departmental request and action view in {PROJECT}, plus plan and decision headings in {DOCS}. Consultation, assignment judgement, actual plan writing, staff communication and later status updates remain distinct phases.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requests, decisions and recurring action fields are handled across separate records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked views and consistent record fields may reduce repeated lookup and entry.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing priorities, resources and people's needs within the head's actual authority.
tasks.human_edge: Leadership, judgement and accountable staff communication.
tasks.altitude: Less administrative record handling around departmental leadership.

reach.learn: Separate an assignment decision from its communication and later progress entry

evidence.claim: Native request, decision and action records may reduce repeated departmental administration; no department-head timing case is supplied in the digest.

assumptions: Broad administrative duty includes its real plans, decisions, assignment records, communication and progress updates. No approval authority beyond the actual department-head remit is assumed.

Head captures request, owner, deadline and current resource source in s1; staff provide needs in s2; head chooses assignments in s3, records decisions and responsibilities in s4 and captures actual progress in s6. All focal capture is priced; missing or conflicting status is clarified manually rather than inferred.
Native linked views and concise record structures come first; no autonomous staff assignment, implicit alert or unlisted send.
Ordinary author saves are fully retained without a self-gate. Staff communication uses the checked final record and is separate from writing it.
unknowns: Actual department-head authority and allocation of administration
research_questions: Can native linked records reduce repeated entry while preserving decision ownership and actual progress?
